title: Static Racked Pallet and Parked Jack
description: One static logistics putaway-position scene: one complete original braced single-bay pallet rack carries one whole original empty wood pallet on the six previously verified finite runner-to-beam patches. A complete original manual pallet jack is parked separately on the floor in front and to the right, with a real gap to the rack. Original pallet-to-rack local pose at height1.25m is retained exactly up to float32 translation storage; both are translated together by the new ground slab height and rearward placement. Only whole-object translations and a new finite floor are authored. Full original local POSITION/NORMAL, material dictionaries and internal hierarchies remain unchanged. One scene and zero independent new models. The upper pallet is pre-placed: this ground-level manual jack is not depicted lifting it and is not connected to it. This is a static racked-storage target and separate parked receiving tool, not the existing fork-engaged floor-pallet loading display renamed. No cargo, rack repetition, lifting trajectory, continuous handling, equipment operation, load capacity, anchoring, seismic, ergonomic or safety claim.
